analysis.analysis: R-109: Testable behavior includes printing framed pages on Seamonkey; boundary is single vs multiple frames; ambiguity is the definition of 'properly'. R-110: Testable behavior includes printing pages with various formats; normal path prints standard formats; abnormal path handles malformed formats; ambiguity is 'various formats'. R-111: Testable behavior includes printing aligned text matching screen display; boundary is left, right, center, and justified alignments. R-112: Testable behavior includes printing indented text matching screen display; boundary is single and nested indentations. R-113: Testable behavior includes printing in portrait and landscape orientations; normal path switches between settings successfully. R-114: Testable behavior includes printing HTML widgets (buttons, inputs, dropdowns); ambiguity is 'properly'. R-115: Testable behavior includes printing raw page source matching screen view. R-116: Testable behavior includes printing CSS-styled pages; boundary includes external, internal, and inline CSS. R-117: Testable behavior includes printing the specific Mozillazine Poll results page; dependency on external URL content stability is a gap. R-118: Testable behavior includes printing large pages; boundary involves multi-page splitting and memory limits; ambiguity is 'large'. R-119: Testable behavior includes printing XML documents; boundary includes raw XML and XML with XSLT. R-120: Testable behavior includes printing popular top web sites; ambiguity is the dynamic list of 'top web sites'. R-121: Testable behavior includes printing HTML 4.0 compliant pages; boundary is strict vs transitional DTDs. R-122: Testable behavior includes printing images; boundary includes various formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF) and missing image links. R-123: Testable behavior includes printing lists; boundary includes ordered, unordered, and nested lists. R-124: Testable behavior includes printing tables; boundary includes multi-page tables, cell padding, and borders; typo in source ('shal'). R-125: Testable behavior includes printing character styles (bold, italic, underline, fonts); ambiguity is exact visual fidelity. R-126: Testable behavior includes printing paragraph styles (line spacing, margins); ambiguity is rendering precision. R-127: Testable behavior includes Print Preview functionality; normal path opens preview matching final print. R-128: Testable behavior includes Page Setup dialog display; boundary includes control responsiveness and layout rendering. R-129: Testable behavior includes off-line printing mode; normal path prints without network connectivity; abnormal path handles missing remote resources. R-130: Testable behavior includes printing headers and footers; boundary includes custom variables (date, title, URL, page numbers). R-131: Testable behavior includes printing specific page ranges; boundary includes single pages, comma-separated lists, and page ranges (e.g., 1-5); abnormal path handles invalid ranges.
